description: This source file provides helper functions related to gateway discovery, including resolving service hosts, generating URLs, and handling gateway connection details within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Returns the trimmed and non-empty host string if valid, otherwise nil.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Generates a host-port tuple for the gateway's service endpoint if the host and port are valid.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string for the gateway based on its host and SSH port.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Generates a secure WebSocket URL for the gateway's direct connection.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket URL (ws or wss) for the provided service host and port, with security considerations.
